device.description: 12-bit 4-channel micro-power SAR ADC with I2C interface, window comparator alarms and interrupt
device.note: ads7924.pdf (SBAS482C) p.3 pin configuration and functions, p.4 recommended operating conditions (DVDD 1.65 V to AVDD, AVDD 2.2-5.5 V), p.5 electrical characteristics (straight binary, VIH to DVDD + 0.3 V, DVDD 1.65-5.5 V), p.6 I2C timing (tVDDAT 0.9 us), p.11-12 data format and conversion timing (tACQ, tCONV 4 us, clock +-20%), p.12-13 INT, PWRCON, alarm, p.13-20 operating modes, p.21 I2C address (Table 2), p.22-25 register write/read (Figures 29-33: pointer byte INC 0 0 P[4:0]), p.26-32 register map (Table 3, Figures 34-56)

registers.name: RESET
registers.note: p.26, p.32 Figure 56: reads the device ID 0001100 A0 (18h with A0 = 0, 19h with A0 = 1); writing AAh is a software reset (not modeled)

registers.name: XFER
registers.note: internal state (not a datasheet register): RST = 1 after a pointer byte addressing RESET (16h) in this write, so that a following data byte 10101010 is the software reset (p.32 Figure 56)

commands.name: Software reset (10101010 written to RESET, 16h)
commands.note: p.32 Figure 56: a write of 10101010 to this register generates a software reset

commands.name: Pointer Address RESET (16h)
commands.note: p.22-25, p.32: sets the pointer to RESET (a read returns the device ID); RESET is read-only, so data bytes other than 10101010 are dropped

commands.name: Pointer Address
commands.note: p.22-25 Figures 29-33: the byte after the address byte is INC (bit 7), 0, 0, P[4:0]; further bytes of the write go to the pointed register; a read returns the pointed register; INC (bit 7) = 1 steps the pointer after each register (Figures 30, 33)

protocol.note: stream frame so that the data byte after a pointer byte to RESET (16h) is decoded; every other pointer byte takes the rest of the write as data for the pointed register, as in a fixed frame

pages: p.3 (pins), p.4 (ROC), p.5 (electrical: straight binary, VIH), p.6 (I2C timing), p.11-13 (data format, conversion timing, INT, PWRCON, alarm), p.13-20 (modes, Table 1, Figures 22-28), p.21 (Table 2 addresses 48h/49h), p.22-25 (Figures 29-33), p.26 (Table 3 register map and reset values), p.27-32 (Figures 34-56, Table 4)
notModeled: analog inputs, multiplexer, MUXOUT/ADCIN break-out and AVDD reference (every conversion returns the 0 V code 000h)

operating modes: MODE[5:0] is split into MODE5_1 (bits 7:3) and MODE0 (bit 2) so that a write of 110000 / 110010 (manual-single / manual-scan) starts one conversion and MODE0 = 1 (the auto modes 110001, 110011, 111001, 111011, 111111) runs continuously; codes the datasheet does not list behave the same way; idle and awake (MODE0 = 0) stop conversions

scan modes convert all four channels in turn starting at SEL/ID; the model converts only the selected channel, so only that channel's DATAx registers load; SEL/ID does not read back the last channel converted

conversion time = tACQ (ACQTIME x 2 us + 6 us) + tCONV 4 us, scaled by 1.2 for the +-20% internal clock; the power-up time tPU (PWRUPTIME x 2 us, applied after idle/awake) and the sleep time of the sleep modes (SLPTIME 2.5-320 ms, SLPDIV4, SLPMULT8) between conversions are not modeled
RESET (16h) reads the device ID 0001100 A0: ID0 follows the A0 pin through pins.levels

alarm: 8-bit window comparators (ULRx/LLRx), alarm counters (ALMCNT), ALRM_ST status bits, AEN/ST read-back of the alarm status, clearing on an INTCNTRL read, and the INT alarm configuration (INTCNFG = 000, the reset value): INT is never driven for alarms

INT: only active-low polarity (INTPOL = 0, the default) is modeled; with INTPOL = 1 the pin stays inactive; busy (INTCNFG 001/011/111) and data ready (010 one conversion, 110 all four conversions: modeled as one conversion) are modeled, static or a 250-ns pulse (INTTRIG); data ready clears when the data registers are read (the datasheet: when the lower four bits are retrieved; the model clears it on any DATAx read)
CONVCTRL (stop conversions at the control event until it is cleared) is stored only
PWRCON pin (external op-amp power control, PWRCONEN / PWRCONPOL, AVDD-referred levels) is never driven; CALCNTL (MUXOUT to AGND) is stored only
power-on values of INTCNTRL bits 7:4, DATAx, ULRx, LLRx are undefined (XXh / X0h): 0 used
I2C bus time-out (25 ms idle), standard / fast mode timing limits; the A0 pin is sampled continuously (the address table follows it)
